earnings.title: Marsh reports third quarter 2026 results
highlights: Revenue Growth of 8%; Underlying Revenue Growth of 5%
GAAP Operating Income Increases 4%; Adjusted Operating Income Increases 6%
Third Quarter GAAP EPS of $1.69; Adjusted EPS Increases 10% to $2.03
Nine Months GAAP EPS of $6.68; Adjusted EPS Increases 9% to $8.29

quotes.text: Marsh delivered a strong third quarter, generating 5% underlying revenue growth and double-digit EPS growth. We also made significant progress in executing our Thrive program and successfully completed our brand transition.
